_help.purpose: Lock preprocessing so NCC values are comparable across runs and students.
how_to_edit: Copy to preprocessing_policy.json and change values only after team agreement.
If you change any key here, record it in experiment notes and commit message.
All curated and scan-bundle runs must reference the same policy file.
_help.important_warning: NCC scores are not comparable if normalization/masking policies differ.
_help.euler_note: Euler angles are interpreted as Bunge ZXZ in degrees.
